## Summary

Changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a per-city sequence.

**`AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`** — the one place the code is minted:
- `CITY3` = upper-cased first 3 letters of the owner's city
- `LAST3` = upper-cased first 3 letters of the last name
- `NNNN` = per-city 4-digit sequence, computed as one more than the owners already in that same city (filtering `findAll()` by city, case-insensitive), replacing the old global count
- Format is now `"%s-%s-%04d"` → e.g. `LON-SMI-0007`

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — `membershipNumber` embeds the `customerCode` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), so it automatically rebuilds on the new format (e.g. `LON-SMI-0007-M26`). I only updated the Javadoc example to match; no logic change was needed since it derives directly from the code.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix` (asserting `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`) passes, as does the full suite.
